claimChallenged: That signatures made with Parmana's default signing key are authentic (docs/CLAIMS.md 2.5, 2.6: verifiable execution evidence). The key's private half, keys/default.private.pem, had been committed to a public GitHub repository.

source.attribution: How the exposure surfaced is not recorded in 04-INCIDENTS-LOG.md INC-1; recorded here as self-identified.

investigationSteps.method: Checked whether the committed key could be fetched by an anonymous clone (04-INCIDENTS-LOG.md INC-1). The exact date is not recorded; this is the latest date the cited sources support.
investigationSteps.observation: Confirmed downloadable by anonymous clone, so anyone could mint valid signatures with it.

finding.statement: Every signature made with that key carries no authenticity guarantee, whenever the signed artifact was created. With no external users at the time, practical damage was nil (INC-1).

outcome.description: The key is treated as permanently compromised and was rotated to a fresh Ed25519 pair on 2026-07-05; keys/ and *.pem are git-ignored; the Key Compromise Notice at the top of docs/CLAIMS.md voids that key's signatures. INC-1 also lists a history purge and archiving a sibling repository as open; docs/CLAIMS.md states this repository's own history does not carry the exposure.

disclosure.location: docs/CLAIMS.md Key Compromise Notice and 04-INCIDENTS-LOG.md INC-1, in this public repository
